benefits.text: The first cushion in hince's Second Skin Base Line, best loved for its gentle formula that gives a smooth, natural-looking finish and helps skin glow naturally. A cushion with a Semi-glow effect and a mild formula that helps it blend easily and leaves skin looking bright and smooth like a pearl.

howToUse.text: Apply the cushion foundation and use concealer on areas that need coverage for a perfected-looking complexion.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: A vegan cushion that creates a light, semi-glow base and helps skin glow naturally.

sellingPoints.text: Semi-glow finish; lightweight, easy-to-blend formula; SPF50+ PA++++ per the product PDF.

texture.text: Smooth liquid cushion base, easy to pat on with a puff.

finish.text: Semi-glow / natural dewy glow / pearly glow.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it perfectly covers every imperfection. SPF does not fully replace sunscreen during prolonged outdoor activity.
